name: Pickles (Dill)
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated on SIBO diet as fermentation is external. Watch sodium content which may affect gut bacteria balance.
preparationTips: Rinse pickles if sensitive to high sodium content
Choose brands without garlic or onion if extra sensitive
Look for naturally fermented varieties for potential probiotic benefits
Avoid sweet pickle varieties which may contain high FODMAP sweeteners
